name: Rules
title: Rules: what Rouh keeps to, and its notes

touches.remove: Delete rouh/rules.py, rouh/web/rules.py, the Rules page and its link here, and this manifest; and the standing rules every run for the person's own work begins with: rules.run_block and its callers in rouh/starting.py (for_the_person, _with_rules), rouh/runs.py (request_of), rouh/one_jobs.py (_redo) and the night's standing_rules=True in rouh/nightly_feature.py. Every instruction a conversation is told is a rule here (rouh/prompting.py puts them together, with the table prompt_part; rouh/ruledefaults.py brings in the defaults every Rouh starts with): taking them out means giving Brain._system in rouh/brain.py a prompt of its own again.
